title: Migrate and rename numeric input types to bevy_ui_widgets
body:
# Objective

- Fixes #25860.

## Solution

- Migrated `NumberInputValue` and `NumberInputRange` from `bevy_feathers` to `bevy_ui_widgets`.
- Renamed them to `NumericValue` and `NumericRange`.

## Testing

- Ran the existing examples using `NumericValue` and `NumericRange`.
  - Confirmed that their behavior remains unchanged.

## AI disclosure

- I used LLM assistance to investigate the existing codebase.
- All changes were reviewed by a human before submission.
